title: Prevention and support

blocks.heading: Prevention and support
blocks.text: Responses can combine prevention, accountable protection and accessible health and social support. Match the actual barrier, such as unsafe disclosure or transport, to a qualified implementer. A campaign alone may not make an existing service reachable.
context_tags: original teaching; fictional examples where stated

blocks.heading: Responses to GBV
blocks.text: Education about respectful relationships, safe reporting routes and survivor-centred professional support can form complementary responses. Confidentiality, safety and non-blaming treatment matter to usable access. A learner should seek help from a trusted responsible adult or qualified service rather than investigate a disclosure.
context_tags: original teaching; fictional examples where stated

blocks.heading: Responses to infant abandonment
blocks.text: Accessible, non-stigmatising pregnancy, parenting, health and social support can address crises and barriers to help. Qualified services must handle immediate safety and child-protection needs. The lesson teaches prevention and referral principles, not current legal advice or instructions for relinquishing a child.
context_tags: original teaching; fictional examples where stated

blocks.heading: A practical access test
blocks.text: Explain the access mechanism in this fictional case: an invented service offers trained confidential support but its remote users cannot afford transport. Suitable support exists but remains difficult to reach; a professionally arranged outreach or transport response could make it usable without compromising privacy.
context_tags: original teaching; fictional examples where stated

blocks.heading: Connect the ideas
blocks.text: Connect to traditional roles (6.1), education (7.3) and research (10.1). Use evidence about resources, voice and practical access. Fictional cases do not establish current law, service availability or a diagnosis about any individual.
context_tags: original teaching; fictional examples where stated
